When I’m not making graphics or pretending I have my life together, I’m probably coding a random project I’ll never finish or starting another side quest instead of doing my actual assignments. Fun fact: I can spend hours debugging one line of code but will ignore my 47 unread notifications like they don’t exist. My sleep schedule is sponsored by poor decisions and the phrase “I’ll do it tomorrow.” Anyway, if you see me online at an unreasonable hour, no you didn’t. 💀
